items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: So I spent the rest of my time in the old post where I was sent by Colonel Gardine... So he looked at me and he said, 'Come here. You'll do.' ... 'I'm sending you up to the old post.'

ctx.x: So I spent the rest of my time in the old post where I was sent by Colonel Gardine, and my duties were we had one rehearsal a week, and every Saturday we had a parade, inspection parade.
Did you get any opportunity to play anything else?
